scenarios.name: complete_valid_campaign
scenarios.mutation: all assigned observations execute and match the independent suite
scenarios.notes: Complete exact-match campaign must pass both safety and usefulness gates.

scenarios.name: zero_false_qualifications_with_confidence_bound
scenarios.mutation: run 10000 independently sampled unsafe cases with no false-qualified outputs
scenarios.notes: Zero observed errors retain a nonzero Wilson upper confidence bound.

scenarios.name: safe_indeterminate_on_known_blocked_case
scenarios.mutation: candidate reports indeterminate where oracle expected blocked
scenarios.notes: Safety gate may pass but exact usefulness/classification gate must fail.

scenarios.name: false_qualified_blocked_case
scenarios.mutation: candidate reports qualified where oracle expected blocked
scenarios.notes: Any unsafe qualification fails the safety gate.

scenarios.name: false_qualified_indeterminate_case
scenarios.mutation: candidate reports qualified where oracle expected indeterminate
scenarios.notes: Unknown evidence must never be promoted to qualified.

scenarios.name: missing_assigned_replicate
scenarios.mutation: omit one case/replicate pair from the candidate result
scenarios.notes: Missing observation makes the campaign incomplete.

scenarios.name: skipped_replicate
scenarios.mutation: record one case as skipped
scenarios.notes: Skipped cases remain in the denominator and prevent campaign completion.

scenarios.name: timed_out_replicate
scenarios.mutation: record a timeout with no observed verdict
scenarios.notes: Timeout is not success and cannot be silently dropped.

scenarios.name: infrastructure_error_replicate
scenarios.mutation: record failed experiment infrastructure
scenarios.notes: Infrastructure errors make campaign incomplete and must remain visible.

scenarios.name: duplicate_case_replicate
scenarios.mutation: include two result records with the same case ID and replicate number
scenarios.notes: Duplicate observations make the result malformed.

scenarios.name: unknown_candidate_case_id
scenarios.mutation: invent a result case not present in the independent suite
scenarios.notes: The candidate cannot enlarge or redefine the suite.

scenarios.name: wrong_suite_digest
scenarios.mutation: supply result bound to another suite digest
scenarios.notes: Expected answers and case denominator are independently fixed.

scenarios.name: wrong_oracle_digest
scenarios.mutation: use a candidate result with a different oracle digest
scenarios.notes: Oracle identity must match the signed benchmark suite.

scenarios.name: easier_workload_digest
scenarios.mutation: use a lower-load workload while claiming a matched run
scenarios.notes: Matched comparisons require identical workload digest.

scenarios.name: larger_resource_budget
scenarios.mutation: give candidate more CPU/memory than the baseline
scenarios.notes: A larger resource budget invalidates matched comparison.

scenarios.name: different_environment
scenarios.mutation: run candidate on different hardware/environment profile
scenarios.notes: Performance comparisons require the same environment digest.

scenarios.name: candidate_supplies_expected_verdict
scenarios.mutation: insert expected field into candidate observation
scenarios.notes: Result schema excludes expected answers; oracle remains external.

scenarios.name: missing_positive_controls
scenarios.mutation: construct suite with no expected-qualified cases
scenarios.notes: A suite without positive controls is invalid.

scenarios.name: missing_unsafe_controls
scenarios.mutation: construct suite containing only expected-qualified cases
scenarios.notes: A suite without blocked/indeterminate cases cannot measure false assurance.

scenarios.name: duplicate_suite_case_id
scenarios.mutation: reuse a case ID with a different expected verdict
scenarios.notes: Case identity must be unique in the independent suite.

scenarios.name: zero_replicate_count
scenarios.mutation: set a suite case replicate count to zero
scenarios.notes: Every case must have at least one assigned replicate.

scenarios.name: executed_without_evidence_digest
scenarios.mutation: return a verdict without result/evidence digests
scenarios.notes: Executed observations must be evidence-addressable.

scenarios.name: skipped_with_verdict
scenarios.mutation: attach an asserted verdict to a skipped or timed-out observation
scenarios.notes: Non-executed observations cannot carry a verdict.

scenarios.name: positive_control_false_rejection
scenarios.mutation: candidate reports blocked or indeterminate for a valid positive control
scenarios.notes: The benchmark must measure usefulness as well as safety.

scenarios.name: unmatched_replicate_pairing
scenarios.mutation: baseline and candidate have different completed case/replicate sets
scenarios.notes: Paired comparisons cannot omit hard cases from either system.

scenarios.name: suite_order_change_without_semantic_change
scenarios.mutation: reorder case array while preserving all case definitions
scenarios.notes: Canonical suite digest must be invariant to case list presentation order.

scenarios.name: false_blended_weighted_score
scenarios.mutation: candidate attempts to compensate false qualification with higher throughput
scenarios.notes: No aggregate score may trade away safety.

scenarios.name: zero_unsafe_trial_denominator
scenarios.mutation: score a campaign without any executed unsafe test case
scenarios.notes: No false-qualification rate is inferred without an unsafe denominator.
